# Medical Professional Bodies

This folder groups professional medical associations that provide clinical guidelines and expert positions informing acute surgical practices and quality indicators in Denmark. The organizations documented here have directly influenced the evidence base for the Danish Acute Surgery Database (AKDB), particularly regarding the use of contrast-enhanced CT scans for patients presenting with acute abdominal pain. Their international and national recommendations support the evaluation and implementation of specific clinical metrics, such as Indikator 3, aimed at improving diagnostic certainty and reducing mortality in acute surgical settings.

## Pages

- [[american-college-of-radiology|American College of radiology]] — The American radiological association whose international guidelines on contrast-enhanced abdominal CT scans inform Danish quality development efforts for acute surgery.
- [[dansk-radiologisk-selskab|Dansk Radiologisk Selskab]] — The Danish Radiological Society, which was consulted for its official position on the use of contrast-enhanced CT scans for patients with acute abdominal pain.
